Epic.Objective: The protagonist must navigate the crucible of a Dominion-dominated world, evolving from an enslaved foreigner into a leader who challenges the local slave order while confronting the risk that his own reliance on power and control replicates the very system he opposes.
Epic.ResolutionCriteria: The local slave operation is destroyed and its captives freed; the protagonist possesses a nascent army and significant power in both Dominion and Sacrifice paths; the wider Dominion order remains intact but recognizes the protagonist as a threat; the protagonist chooses to continue the fight against the broader system.
Epic.InitialPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
Epic.FirstMilestone: The protagonist dies on Earth while shielding a noncombatant mother during a battle, an act intended to save her life that raises him to Sacrifice Level 1 and initializes the System.

LongChildren.Objective: The protagonist must survive the immediate aftermath of his resurrection, navigate the disorientation of a new world, and endure the initial enslavement that defines his starting social status and physical constraints.
LongChildren.ResolutionCriteria: The protagonist is chained, assessed as valuable stock, and sold into the local slave system; he has begun the process of adapting to the new environment despite lacking local language and cultural knowledge; the System interface is visible but uninterpreted.

LongChildren.Objective: The protagonist must leverage his military training and System-directed growth to rise within the slave hierarchy, gaining privileges and authority over other prisoners while building a covert network of allies.
LongChildren.ResolutionCriteria: The protagonist holds a position of authority within the slave system, possessing privileges that make him valuable to his owners; he has established a covert network of allies among the prisoners; he has gained early abilities in both Dominion and Sacrifice paths.
LongChildren.InitialPhase: The protagonist is alive on Earth as an eighteen-year-old Marine, having accumulated Dominion Level 1 through selfish and manipulative actions, but has not yet performed the act of sacrifice that will initialize the System. He is in a state of pre-death existence, unaware of the metaphysical consequences of his upcoming actions.
